snippet.title: Is This the Brutal Dieselpunk Heavy Artillery Simulator You’ve Been Waiting For?
snippet.description:
✅ 𝐈𝐍𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝐏𝐋𝐀𝐘𝐓𝐄𝐒𝐓𝐒 ➙ Live on Discord (will continue until release)
❎ 𝐈𝐍𝐓𝐄𝐑𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝐃𝐄𝐌𝐎 ➙ NEST FEST (Feb 23 ➙ Mar 2, 2026)
✅ 𝐏𝐔𝐁𝐋𝐈𝐂 𝐃𝐄𝐌𝐎 & 𝐑𝐄𝐋𝐄𝐀𝐒𝐄 𝐃𝐀𝐓𝐄 𝐑𝐄𝐕𝐄𝐀𝐋 ➙ June 15, 2026 during Steam Next Fest 
⛔️ 𝐅𝐔𝐋𝐋 𝐆𝐀𝐌𝐄 ➙ August 6, 2026

𝘈𝘣𝘰𝘶𝘵:
IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator is a brutal dieselpunk artillery experience where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Every lever, every dial and every shot is under your control. High Command may send cryptic orders, but you alone pull the trigger. Obey or defy, in this nest you are the god of steel and fire. Beware, each blast tears the silence!

𝘚𝘰𝘤𝘪𝘢𝘭 𝘔𝘦𝘥𝘪𝘢:
🟪 Discord ➙  https://discord.gg/ironnestgame
🌳 Linktr.ee ➙ https://linktr.ee/IRONNEST
🛍️ Steam ➙ https://store.steampowered.com/app/2950790/IRON_NEST_Heavy_Turret_Simulator/

𝘏𝘢𝘴𝘩𝘵𝘢𝘨𝘴:
#IndieGame #TurretSimulator #Dieselpunk #WarGame #Action  #Strategy #Artillery #Simulation
